label: Cartesian adequacy has a qualified cause scope
summary: The pinned witnesses confirm the rejection of the unrestricted reading. Second Replies axiom IV names the first and adequate cause. Axiom V requires a cause containing the idea’s objective reality formally or eminently. Meditation III §§14–15 starts with the efficient and total cause and allows one idea to arise from another while requiring a first archetype. These passages support containment at a qualified cause and leave partial-cause adequacy open.
blocker: Supply a total or adequate cause and map its formal-or-eminent containment to the same modeled respect. A universal conclusion over partial ObjCause witnesses needs a separate justification.
